PLAN "Prenatal Strength: 20-32 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength safely through third trimester"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          hip_circles 1x10
          glute_bridge 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1x10
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rest 30 seconds

          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1x10
          bird_dog 2x10 rest 30 seconds
